rows.jyutping: deoi3 A ge3 tai2 m4 hei2
rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken construction for expressing contempt or scorn toward someone or something.

example.english: I have a deep disdain for people who throw their weight around.
example.traditional: 我對嗰啲恃勢凌人嘅人，真係有種發自內心嘅睇唔起。
example.jyutping: ngo5 deoi3 go2 di1 si5 sai3 ling4 jan4 ge3 jan4 zan1 hai6 jau5 zung2 faat3 zi6 noi6 sam1 ge3 tai2 m4 hei2
